source: Drik Panchang Pradosh lists for New Delhi (bare pradoshdates.html defaults to Delhi; ?year=2027 for 2027), read 2026-10-11 via webfetch (text format). Drik's rule, stated on the page: the day is fixed when Trayodashi falls during Pradosh Kaal after sunset; one date per paksha (max overlap). Monthly vrats recur in adhika months (May 28, Jun 12, Jun 27 all Jyeshtha 2026).

decisive_cases.2026-03-01: Phalguna Shukla Trayodashi begins 08:43 PM Feb 28, ends 07:09 PM Mar 01; Feb 28 pradosh holds ~0 min, Mar 1 holds 48 min. Drik: Mar 1 (Ravi Pradosh).
